title: Microsoft Purview: Adaptive Scope evaluation control with recipient and site owner lifecycle status
description: Microsoft Purview Adaptive Scopes will provide administrators with explicit control over lifecycle-state evaluation for recipients and site owners, helping ensure policy targeting and scope membership remain aligned with organizational requirements.
